newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Rieter details share repurchase offer.
newsitem.headline: Rieter details share repurchase offer.

text.p: Textile machinery and automotive systems maker Rieter Holding said it was offering to repurchase up to 225,000 registered shares from shareholders.
Rieter said the offer would expire on April 14 and was subject to approval by the annual general meeting of shareholders on May 22.
In a letter to shareholders, Rieter said it was offering a gross price of 440 Swiss francs per share or a net price of 286 francs after a 35-percent withholding tax.

"The effect of the transaction will be for the benefit of all shareholders, since profits will in future be divided among fewer shares, thus increasing earnings per share," Rieter said in an accompnaying statement to shareholders on its 1996 reults.

Rieter said it would also ask the shareholder meeting to approve a reduction in Rieter share capital by the par value of the securities that are repurchased, up to a maximum of 4.5 million Swiss francs.
Rieter said shareholders would be informed of the allocation made on May 2 together with the invitation to the annual general meeting.
"If more than the maximum number of shares are tendered, tenders will be reduced pro rata, and allocation will be made on the reduced basis," Riter said.
It said payment of the purchase price would be made with value dated April 21, 1997. -- Zurich Newsroom, +41-1-631 7340
